verdict.rationale: Workable documents a no-code, branded, mobile-friendly careers page with custom layout, colors, fonts and media. It also offers an automatically updating branded job-list widget you can embed on your existing website, so jobs reach your own site without engineering work. Mapping the hosted careers page itself to a custom domain is not documented, and that the hosted page auto-publishes ATS jobs is only implied. missing for 10: explicit custom-domain support for the hosted careers page, explicit statement that jobs publish from the ATS to the hosted page, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work

citations.quote: Create a branded, mobile-friendly careers page with built-in search, filtering, and auto-fill applications without coding skills. Brand with custom layout, brand colors, fonts and media.
Embed an automatically updating, branded job list on your existing website using a simple, customizable widget.
